units.zh: 五行之精氣，在天為五緯，在地為五材，在人為五常及五事。
units.en: The refined qi of the Five Elements becomes the five planets in Heaven, the five materials on Earth, and in humanity the Five Constants and the Five Affairs.
units.literal: The quintessential qi of the Five Elements—in Heaven are the five planets, on Earth the five materials, in humanity the Five Constants and the Five Affairs.

units.zh: 五緯志諸《天文》，歷代皆然。
units.en: The five planets are recorded in the Astronomy treatises, as every dynasty has done.
units.literal: Records of the five planets belong in the Astronomy treatises, as in every dynasty.

units.zh: 其形質在地，性情在人，休咎各以其類，為感應於兩間者，歷代又有《五行志》焉。
units.en: Form and substance belong to Earth, disposition to humanity; auspicious and inauspicious signs each keep to their kind—as resonances between the two realms—and dynasties have also compiled Treatises on the Five Elements.
units.literal: Their form and substance lie on Earth, their disposition in humanity; auspicious and inauspicious signs each follow their kind—as responses between the two realms—dynasties have also compiled Treatises on the Five Elements.

units.zh: 兩漢以來，儒者若夏侯勝之徒，專以《洪範五行》為學，作史者多采其說，凡言某征之休咎，則以某事之得失系之，而配之以五行。
units.en: Since the Two Han, scholars such as Xiahou Sheng took the Hong Fan's Five Elements as their whole craft; historians mostly followed them—whenever they judged an omen auspicious or inauspicious, they bound it to some affair's success or failure and paired it with the Five Elements.
units.literal: Since the Two Han, scholars such as Xia Hou Sheng made the Hong Fan's Five Elements their sole study; historians mostly adopted their views—whenever they spoke of the auspicious or inauspicious bearing of some omen, they tied it to the success or failure of some affair and matched it to the Five Elements.

units.zh: 謂其盡然，其弊不免于傅會；
units.en: To hold this wholly true cannot escape the fault of forced correlation;
units.literal: To hold this wholly true cannot escape the fault of forced correlation;

units.zh: 謂其不然，「肅，時雨若」、「蒙，恆風若」之類，箕子蓋嘗言之。
units.en: to hold it wholly false—sayings such as "With respect, seasonable rain follows" and "With obscurity, constant wind follows"—Jizi surely spoke them.
units.literal: to hold it wholly false—sayings such as "With respect, seasonable rain follows" and "With obscurity, constant wind follows"—Jizi surely spoke them.

units.zh: 金世未能一天下，天文災祥猶有星野之說，五行休咎見於國內者不得他諉，乃匯其史氏所書，仍前史法，作《五行志》。
units.en: The Jin age had not united the realm; celestial disaster and blessing still invoked the doctrine of stellar fields, yet Five Elements omens seen within their borders could not be blamed on others—so they gathered what their historians recorded, following earlier annalistic form, and composed this Treatise on the Five Elements.
units.literal: The Jin age could not unite all under Heaven; celestial disaster and blessing still spoke of astrological fields, but Five Elements omens appearing within the realm could not be blamed elsewhere—so they gathered what their historians wrote, following earlier annalistic form, and composed this Treatise on the Five Elements.

units.zh: 至於五常五事之感應，則不必泥漢儒為例雲。
units.en: As for responses of the Five Constants and Five Affairs, there is no need to bind oneself to Han Confucian precedent.
units.literal: As for responses of the Five Constants and Five Affairs, there is no need to bind oneself to Han Confucian precedent.

units.zh: 初，金之興，平定諸部，屢有禎異，故世祖每與敵戰，嘗以夢寐卜其勝負。
units.en: When the Jin first rose and pacified the tribes, portents came again and again—so Shizu, whenever he met the enemy in battle, would read victory or defeat in his dreams.
units.literal: At the Jin rise, pacifying the tribes, miraculous signs recurred again and again—hence the Shizu Emperor, whenever he fought enemies, would read victory or defeat in his dreams.

units.zh: 烏春兵至蘇東海甸，世祖曰：「予夙昔有異夢，不可親戰，若左軍有力戰者當克。」
units.en: When Wuchun's army reached the Suhai pasturelands, Shizu said: "Long ago I had an uncanny dream—I must not fight in person; if someone on the left wing fights with all his strength, we shall win."
units.literal: When Wuchun's army reached the Suhai pasturelands, Shizu said: "I had an uncanny dream of old—I must not fight in person; if someone on the left wing fights with full force, we shall win."

units.zh: 既而與肅宗等擊之，敵大敗。
units.en: Thereupon he and Suzong and others struck them, and the enemy was routed.
units.literal: Thereupon he and Suzong and others struck them, and the enemy was routed.

units.zh: 太祖之生也，常有五色雲氣若二千斛廩囷之狀，屢見東方。
units.en: At the Founder Ancestor's birth, five-colored cloud-qi often shaped like a two-thousand-bushel granary-bin was seen again and again in the east.
units.literal: At the Founder Ancestor's birth, five-colored cloud-qi often shaped like a two-thousand-bushel granary-bin was seen again and again in the east.

units.zh: 遼司天到孔致和曰：「其下當生異人，建非常之事，天以象告，非人力所能為也。」
units.en: Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what no human hand can make."
units.literal: Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what human effort cannot bring about."

units.zh: 溫都部跋忒畔，穆宗遣太祖討之，入辭，奏曰：「昨夕見赤祥，往必克。」
units.en: When the Wendu tribal chief Bate rebelled, Muzong sent the Founder Ancestor to subdue him; on taking leave he reported: "Last night I saw a crimson auspice—we shall win when we go."
units.literal: When the Wendu tribal chief Bate rebelled, Muzong sent the Founder Ancestor to subdue him; on taking leave he reported: "Last night I saw a crimson auspice—we shall win when we go."

units.zh: 遂與跋忒戰，殺之。
units.en: He fought Bate and killed him.
units.literal: He fought Bate and killed him.

units.zh: 穆宗攻阿疏日，辰巳間，忽暴雨昏曀，雷電環阿疏所居，是夕有巨火聲如雷，墜阿疏城中，遂攻下之。
units.en: When Muzong besieged Ashuri, between the chen and si hours a violent rainstorm darkened the sky; lightning ringed Ashuri's dwelling; that night a great fire, loud as thunder, fell into Ashuri's town—and the place was taken.
units.literal: When Muzong besieged Ashuri, between the chen and si hours a violent rainstorm darkened the sky; lightning ringed Ashuri's dwelling; that night a great fire, thunder-loud, fell into Ashuri's town—and the place was taken.

units.zh: 太祖嘗往甯江，夢斡帶之禾場焚，頃刻而盡。
units.en: The Founder Ancestor once went to Ningjiang and dreamed that Wandai's threshing-floor burned to nothing in an instant.
units.literal: The Founder Ancestor once went to Ningjiang and dreamed that Wandai's threshing-floor burned to nothing in an instant.

units.zh: 覺而大戚，即馳還，斡帶已寢疾，翌日不起。
units.en: Waking, he grieved deeply and galloped back—Wandai had already taken to his bed, and the next day would not rise.
units.literal: Waking, he grieved deeply and galloped back—Wandai had already taken to his bed, and the next day would not rise.

units.zh: 斡塞伐高麗，太祖臥而得夢，及起曰：「今日捷音必至。」
units.en: When Wosai campaigned against Goryeo, the Founder Ancestor slept and dreamed; on rising he said: "Today the news of victory must arrive."
units.literal: When Wosai campaigned against Goryeo, the Founder Ancestor slept and dreamed; on rising he said: "Today the news of victory must arrive."

units.zh: 乃為具於球場以待。
units.en: He had a feast laid on the ball-court to await it.
units.literal: He had a feast laid on the ball-court to await it.

units.zh: 有二麞渡水而至，獲之，太祖曰：「此休征也。」
units.en: Two roe deer crossed the water and were taken; the Founder Ancestor said: "This is an auspicious omen."
units.literal: Two roe deer crossed the water and were taken; the Founder Ancestor said: "This is an auspicious omen."

units.zh: 言未既，捷書至，眾大異之。
units.en: He had scarcely finished when the victory dispatch arrived—and the whole camp stood amazed.
units.literal: The words were barely spoken when the victory dispatch arrived—the crowd marveled greatly.

units.zh: 他日軍甯江，駐高阜，撒改仰見太祖體如喬松，所乘馬如岡阜之大，太祖亦視撒改人馬異常，撒改因白所見，太祖喜曰：「此吉兆也。」
units.en: Another day, campaigning at Ningjiang, they halted on a high mound; Sacai looking up saw the Founder Ancestor's body like a towering pine, his mount like a hill-crest in scale; the Founder Ancestor also saw Sacai's horse and men extraordinary. Sacai told what he had seen; the Founder Ancestor rejoiced: "This is a lucky sign."
units.literal: Another day, campaigning at Ningjiang, they halted on a high mound; Sacai looking up saw the Founder Ancestor's body like a towering pine, his mount like a hill-crest in scale; the Founder Ancestor also saw Sacai's horse and men extraordinary. Sacai told what he had seen; the Founder Ancestor rejoiced: "This is a lucky sign."

units.zh: 即舉酒酹之曰：「異日成功，當識此地。」
units.en: He raised wine and libated, saying: "When we succeed another day, remember this place."
units.literal: He raised wine and libated, saying: "When we succeed another day, remember this place."

units.zh: 師次唐括帶斡甲之地，諸軍介而立，有光起於人足及戈矛上，明日，至劄只水，光復如初。
units.en: The army halted at Tangkuodaiwogan; the troops stood arrayed, and light rose from men's feet and from spear-points; the next day, reaching Zhazhi River, the light appeared as before.
units.literal: The army halted at Tangkuodaiwogan; the troops stood arrayed, and light rose from men's feet and from spear-points; the next day, reaching Zhazhi River, the light appeared as before.

units.zh: 收國元年，上在甯江州，有光正圓，自空而墜。
units.en: In the first year of Shouguo, the sovereign was at Ningjiang; a perfectly round light fell from the sky.
units.literal: In the first year of Shouguo, the sovereign was at Ningjiang; a perfectly round light fell from the sky.

units.zh: 八月己卯，黃龍見空中。
units.en: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, a yellow dragon appeared in the sky.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, a yellow dragon appeared in the sky.

units.zh: 十二月丁未，上候遼軍還至熟結濼，有光復見於矛端。
units.en: In the twelfth month, dingwei, the sovereign waited for Liao forces, returning to Shujie Marsh—and the light was seen again on spear-tips.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, dingwei, the sovereign waited for Liao forces, returning to Shujie Marsh—and the light was seen again on spear-tips.

units.zh: 天輔六年三月，師攻西京，有火如鬥，墜其城中。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianfu, third month, the army besieged Western Capital; a fire the size of a dipper-measure fell into its walls.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu, third month, the army besieged Western Capital; a fire the size of a dipper-measure fell into its walls.

units.zh: 是月，城降而複叛，四月辛卯，取之。
units.en: That month the city surrendered then rebelled again; in the fourth month, xinmao, it was taken.
units.literal: That month the city surrendered then rebelled again; in the fourth month, xinmao, it was taken.

units.zh: 太宗天會二年，曷懶移鹿古水霖雨害稼，且為蝗所食。
units.en: Taizong, second year of Tianhui, at Yilanyilugu River—incessant rain harmed the crops, and locusts devoured them besides.
units.literal: Taizong, second year of Tianhui, at Yilanyilugu River—incessant rain harmed the crops, and locusts devoured them besides.

units.zh: 秋，泰州潦，害稼。
units.en: In autumn, Taizhou flooded, ruining the harvest.
units.literal: In autumn, Taizhou flooded, ruining the harvest.

units.zh: 三年七月，錦州野蠶成繭。
units.en: Third year, seventh month—at Jinzhou wild silkworms formed cocoons.
units.literal: Third year, seventh month—at Jinzhou wild silkworms formed cocoons.

units.zh: 九月，廣寧府進嘉禾。
units.en: Ninth month—Guangning Prefecture presented auspicious grain.
units.literal: Ninth month—Guangning Prefecture presented auspicious grain.

units.zh: 四年十月，中京進嘉禾。
units.en: Fourth year, tenth month—Central Capital presented auspicious grain.
units.literal: Fourth year, tenth month—Central Capital presented auspicious grain.

units.zh: 六年冬，移懶路饑。
units.en: Sixth year, winter—Yilan circuit suffered famine.
units.literal: Sixth year, winter—Yilan circuit suffered famine.

units.zh: 九年七月丙申，上禦西樓聽政，聞咸州所貢白鵲音忽異常，上起視之，見東樓上光明中有像巍然高五丈許，下有紅雲承之，若世所謂佛者，乃擎跽修虔，久之而沒。
units.en: Ninth year, seventh month, bingshen—the sovereign held court on the west tower and heard the white magpie presented from Xianzhou cry oddly; he rose to look and saw on the east tower, within a blaze of light, a figure towering some five zhang, red cloud beneath bearing it up like the Buddha the world knows—he raised his joined hands in reverence until it vanished.
units.literal: Ninth year, seventh month, bingshen—the sovereign held court on the west tower and heard the white magpie presented from Xianzhou cry oddly; he rose to look and saw on the east tower, within a blaze of light, a figure towering some five zhang, red cloud beneath bearing it up like the Buddha the world knows—he raised his joined hands in reverence until it vanished.

units.zh: 十年冬，移懶、曷懶等路饑。
units.en: Tenth year, winter—Yilan, Yilanyilugu, and other circuits starved.
units.literal: Tenth year, winter—Yilan, Yilanyilugu, and other circuits starved.

units.zh: 熙宗天會十三年五月，甘露降于盧州熊嶽縣。
units.en: Xizong, thirteenth year of Tianhui, fifth month—sweet dew fell in Xiongyue County, Luzhou.
units.literal: Xizong, thirteenth year of Tianhui, fifth month—sweet dew fell in Xiongyue County, Luzhou.

units.zh: 十五年七月辛巳，有司進四足雀。
units.en: Fifteenth year, seventh month, xinsi—the authorities presented a four-footed sparrow.
units.literal: Fifteenth year, seventh month, xinsi—the authorities presented a four-footed sparrow.

units.zh: 丙戌夜，京師地震。
units.en: On the night of bingxu the capital shook in earthquake.
units.literal: On the night of bingxu the capital shook in earthquake.

units.zh: 天眷元年夏，有龍見於熙州野水，凡三日。
units.en: First year of Tianjuan, summer—a dragon was seen in the wild waters of Xizhou, for three days in all.
units.literal: First year of Tianjuan, summer—a dragon was seen in the wild waters of Xizhou, for three days in all.

units.zh: 初，于水面見一蒼龍，良久而沒。
units.en: At first an azure dragon showed on the water's face and, after a long while, sank away.
units.literal: At first an azure dragon showed on the water's face and, after a long while, sank away.

units.zh: 次日，見金龍一，爪承一嬰兒，兒為龍所戲，略無懼色，三日如故。
units.en: The next day a golden dragon appeared, its claw bearing an infant the dragon sported with—the child showing no fear—for three days unchanged.
units.literal: The next day a golden dragon appeared, its claw bearing an infant the dragon sported with—the child showing no fear—for three days unchanged.

units.zh: 又見一人，乘白馬，紅袍玉帶，如少年官狀，馬前有六蟾蜍，凡三時乃沒，郡人競往觀之。
units.en: Again a man was seen, riding a white horse in red robe and jade belt like a youthful officer, six toads before his horse; after three watch-periods all vanished, and the county folk rushed to see.
units.literal: Again a man was seen, riding a white horse in red robe and jade belt like a youthful officer, six toads before his horse; after three watch-periods all vanished, and the county folk rushed to see.

units.zh: 七月丁酉，按出滸河溢，壞民廬舍。
units.en: Seventh month, dingyou—the Anchu River burst its banks, wrecking commoners' homes.
units.literal: Seventh month, dingyou—the Anchu River burst its banks, wrecking commoners' homes.

units.zh: 三年十二月丁丑，地震。
units.en: Third year, twelfth month, dingchou—earthquake.
units.literal: Third year, twelfth month, dingchou—earthquake.

units.zh: 皇統元年秋，蝗。
units.en: In the first year of Huangtong, autumn brought locusts.
units.literal: In the first year of Huangtong, in autumn, there were locusts.

units.zh: 十一月己酉，稽古殿火。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, the Hall for Examining Antiquity burned.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, the Hall for Examining Antiquity caught fire.

units.zh: 二年二月，熙河路饑。
units.en: In the second year, second month, famine struck Xihe Circuit.
units.literal: In the second year, second month, Xihe Circuit suffered famine.

units.zh: 三月辛丑，大雪。
units.en: In the third month, on xinchou, heavy snow fell.
units.literal: In the third month, on xinchou, there was heavy snow.

units.zh: 秋，燕、西東二京、河東、河北、山東、汴、平州大熟。
units.en: In autumn, Yan, the Western and Eastern Capitals, Hedong, Hebei, Shandong, Bian, and Pingzhou enjoyed abundant harvests.
units.literal: In autumn, Yan, the Western and Eastern Capitals, Hedong, Hebei, Shandong, Bian, and Pingzhou had great harvests.

units.zh: 三年，陝西旱。
units.en: In the third year, Shaanxi suffered drought.
units.literal: In the third year, Shaanxi suffered drought.

units.zh: 五月丁巳，京兆府貢瑞麥。
units.en: In the fifth month, on dingsi, Jingzhao Prefecture presented auspicious wheat.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on dingsi, Jingzhao Prefecture presented auspicious wheat.

units.zh: 七月丙庚，太原進獬豸及瑞麥。
units.en: In the seventh month, on binggeng, Taiyuan presented a xiezhi and auspicious wheat.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on binggeng, Taiyuan presented a xiezhi and auspicious wheat.

units.zh: 四年正月乙丑，陝西進嘉禾，十有二莖，一本七穎。
units.en: In the fourth year, first month, on yichou, Shaanxi presented auspicious grain: twelve stalks, one root bearing seven ears.
units.literal: In the fourth year, first month, on yichou, Shaanxi presented auspicious grain: twelve stalks, with one root bearing seven ears.

units.zh: 十月甲辰，地震。
units.en: In the tenth month, on jiachen, the earth shook.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on jiachen, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 五年閏月戊寅，大名府進牛生麟。
units.en: In the fifth year, intercalary month, on wuyin, Daming Prefecture presented a cow that had borne a unicorn.
units.literal: In the fifth year, intercalary month, on wuyin, Daming Prefecture presented a cow that had given birth to a unicorn.

units.zh: 壬辰，懷州進嘉禾。
units.en: On renchen, Huaizhou presented auspicious grain.
units.literal: On renchen, Huaizhou presented auspicious grain.

units.zh: 七年十一月，完顏秉德進三角牛。
units.en: In the seventh year, eleventh month, Wanyan Bingde presented a three-horned ox.
units.literal: In the seventh year, eleventh month, Wanyan Bingde presented a three-horned ox.

units.zh: 九年四月壬申夜，大風雨，雷電震寢殿鴟尾壞。
units.en: In the ninth year, fourth month, on the night of renshen, violent wind and rain came; thunder and lightning struck and damaged the owl-tail finials of the sleeping hall.
units.literal: In the ninth year, fourth month, on the night of renshen, great wind and rain came; thunder and lightning struck, and the owl-tail finials of the sleeping hall were damaged.

units.zh: 有火入帝寢，燒帷幔，上懼，徙別殿。
units.en: Fire entered the emperor’s sleeping chamber and burned the curtains; frightened, the emperor moved to another hall.
units.literal: Fire entered the emperor’s sleeping chamber and burned the curtains; the emperor was frightened and moved to another hall.

units.zh: 丁丑，有龍鬥於利州榆林河上。
units.en: On dingchou, dragons fought above the Yulin River in Lizhou.
units.literal: On dingchou, dragons fought above the Yulin River in Lizhou.

units.zh: 大風壞民居官舍十六七，木瓦人畜皆飄揚十餘裏，死傷者數百，同知州事石抹裏壓死。
units.en: A great wind wrecked six or seven tenths of commoners’ dwellings and official buildings; timber, tiles, people, and livestock were blown more than ten li, several hundred were killed or injured, and Vice Prefect Shimo Li was crushed to death.
units.literal: A great wind destroyed six or seven tenths of commoners’ dwellings and official buildings; timber, tiles, people, and livestock were all blown more than ten li, several hundred were killed or injured, and Vice Prefect Shimo Li was crushed to death.

units.zh: 海陵天德二年十二月，野人采石炭，獲異香。
units.en: Hailing, twelfth month of the second year of Tiande—a countryman mining coal found a strange fragrance.
units.literal: Hailing, twelfth month of the second year of Tiande—a countryman mining coal found a strange fragrance.

units.zh: 貞元三年五月癸丑，南京大內災。
units.en: Third year of Zhenyuan, fifth month, guichou—fire disaster in the Nanjing inner palace.
units.literal: Third year of Zhenyuan, fifth month, guichou—fire disaster in the Nanjing inner palace.

units.zh: 三年十二月己丑，雨，木冰。
units.en: Twelfth month, jichou—it rained, and the trees were sheathed in ice.
units.literal: Twelfth month, jichou—rain, and trees armored in ice.

units.zh: 正隆二年六月壬辰，蝗飛入京師。
units.en: Zhenglong, second year, sixth month, on renchen: locusts flew into the capital.
units.literal: Zhenglong, second year, sixth month, on renchen: locusts flew into the capital.

units.zh: 秋，中都、山東、河東蝗。
units.en: In autumn locusts struck the Central Capital, Shandong, and Hedong.
units.literal: Autumn: locusts in the Central Capital, Shandong, and Hedong.

units.zh: 四年十一月庚寅，霜附木。
units.en: Fourth year, eleventh month, on gengyin: frost clung to the trees.
units.literal: Fourth year, eleventh month, on gengyin: frost clung to trees.

units.zh: 五年二月辛未，河東、陝西地震。
units.en: Fifth year, second month, on xinwei: earthquakes in Hedong and Shaanxi.
units.literal: Fifth year, second month, on xinwei: earthquakes in Hedong and Shaanxi.

units.zh: 鎮戎、德順等軍大風，壞廬舍，民多壓死。
units.en: At Zhenrong, Deshun, and other armies a great wind destroyed dwellings and crushed many people to death.
units.literal: At Zhenrong, Deshun, and other armies a great wind destroyed dwellings; many people were crushed to death.

units.zh: 海陵問司天馬貴中等曰：「何為地震？」
units.en: Hailing asked Ma Guizhong of the Directorate of Astronomy and others: "What causes an earthquake?"
units.literal: Hailing asked Ma Guizhong of the Directorate of Astronomy and others, saying: "What causes an earthquake?"

units.zh: 貴中等曰：「伏陽逼陰所致。」
units.en: Ma Guizhong and the others said: "Submerged yang pressing yin causes it."
units.literal: Ma Guizhong and the others said: "It comes of submerged yang pressing yin."

units.zh: 又問：「震而大風，何也？」
units.en: He asked again: "When earthquake comes with great wind, what does that mean?"
units.literal: He asked again: "When there is earthquake and great wind, what of it?"

units.zh: 對曰：「土失其性，則地以震。
units.en: They replied: "When earth loses its proper nature, the ground quakes.
units.literal: They replied: "When earth loses its proper nature, the ground quakes.

units.zh: 風為號令，人君嚴急則有風及物之災。」
units.en: Wind is command; when the ruler is harsh and urgent, wind disasters reach things as well."
units.literal: Wind is command; when the ruler is harsh and urgent there are winds and disasters reaching things."

units.zh: 六年六月壬戌，大風壞承天門鴟尾。
units.en: Sixth year, sixth month, on renxu: a great wind destroyed the owl-tail ridge ornaments of Chengtian Gate.
units.literal: Sixth year, sixth month, on renxu: a great wind destroyed the owl-tail ridge ornaments of Chengtian Gate.

units.zh: 是歲，世宗居貞懿皇后憂，在遼陽，一日方寢，有紅光照其室，及其龍見於室上，又夜有大星流入其邸。
units.en: That year Shizong was mourning Empress Zhenyi at Liaoyang; one day as he slept a red light filled his chamber, a dragon appeared above the room, and by night a great star streamed into his residence.
units.literal: That year Shizong was in mourning for Empress Zhenyi at Liaoyang; one day as he slept a red light filled his chamber, and a dragon appeared above the room; by night a great star streamed into his residence.

units.zh: 八月，複有雲氣自西來，黃龍見其中，人皆見之。
units.en: In the eighth month cloud-vapor came again from the west with a yellow dragon within it; everyone saw it.
units.literal: In the eighth month cloud-vapor came again from the west, and a yellow dragon appeared within it; everyone saw it.

units.zh: 是時，臨潢府聞空中有車馬聲，仰視見風雲杳靄，神鬼兵甲蔽天，自北而南，仍有語促行者。
units.en: At that time Linhuang Prefecture heard chariots and horses in the sky; looking up they saw misty wind and cloud, spirit soldiers in armor filling the sky from north to south, and voices urging travelers on.
units.literal: At that time Linhuang Prefecture heard the sound of chariots and horses in the sky; looking up they saw wind and cloud misty and dim, spirits and ghosts with armor filling heaven from north to south, and still voices urging travelers on.

units.zh: 未歲，海陵下詔南征。
units.en: Before the year was out, Hailing issued an edict for the southern campaign.
units.literal: Before the year was out, Hailing issued an edict for the southern campaign.

units.zh: 世宗大定二年閏二月辛卯，神龍殿十六位焚，延及太和、厚德殿。
units.en: Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shenlong Hall burned and the fire spread to Taihe and Houde halls.
units.literal: Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shenlong Hall burned, spreading to Taihe and Houde halls.

units.zh: 三年三月丙申，中都以南八路蝗。
units.en: Third year, third month, on bingshen: locusts in the Eight Routes south of the Central Capital.
units.literal: Third year, third month, on bingshen: locusts in the Eight Routes south of the Central Capital.

units.zh: 四年三月庚子夜，京師地震。
units.en: Fourth year, third month, on gengzi at night: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
units.literal: Fourth year, third month, on gengzi night: earthquake in the capital.

units.zh: 七年辛丑，大風雷雨，拔木。
units.en: Seventh year, xinchou: great wind, thunder, and rain uprooted trees.
units.literal: Seventh year, xinchou: great wind, thunder, and rain; trees were uprooted.

units.zh: 臨潢府境禾黍穞生。
units.en: Within Linhuang Prefecture millet and grain put forth second growth.
units.literal: Within Linhuang Prefecture millet and grain put forth second growth.

units.zh: 嵐州進白兔二。
units.en: Lan Prefecture presented two white rabbits.
units.literal: Lan Prefecture presented two white rabbits.

units.zh: 八月，永興進嘉禾，異畝同穎。
units.en: Eighth month: Yongxing presented auspicious grain with different stalks sharing one ear.
units.literal: Eighth month: Yongxing presented auspicious grain with different stalks sharing one ear.

units.zh: 中都南八路蝗飛入京畿。
units.en: Locusts in the Eight Routes south of the Central Capital flew into the capital region.
units.literal: Locusts in the Eight Routes south of the Central Capital flew into the capital region.

units.zh: 十一月辛丑，尚書省火。
units.en: Eleventh month, on xinchou: fire at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou: fire at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 是歲，有年。
units.en: That year brought a good harvest.
units.literal: That year was a good harvest.

units.zh: 五年六月戊子，河南府進芝草十三本，得于芝田石上，薦之太廟。
units.en: Fifth year, sixth month, on wuzi: Henan Prefecture presented thirteen stalks of lingzhi found on a lingzhi-field stone; they were offered at the Grand Temple.
units.literal: Fifth year, sixth month, on wuzi: Henan Prefecture presented thirteen stalks of lingzhi, found on a lingzhi-field stone; they were offered at the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 六月甲辰，大安殿楹產芝，有色如玉。
units.en: Sixth month, on jiachen: lingzhi grew on a pillar of Da'an Hall, colored like jade.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jiachen: lingzhi grew on a pillar of Da'an Hall, colored like jade.

units.zh: 丙午，京師地震，有聲自西北來，殷殷如雷，地生白毛。
units.en: On bingwu the capital was shaken by earthquake; a sound came from the northwest, deep as thunder, and white hair grew from the ground.
units.literal: On bingwu the capital was shaken by earthquake; a sound came from the northwest, deep as thunder, and white hair grew from the ground.

units.zh: 七月戊申，又震。
units.en: Seventh month, on wushen: earthquake again.
units.literal: Seventh month, on wushen: earthquake again.

units.zh: 十一月癸酉，大霧，晝晦。
units.en: Eleventh month, on guiyou: great fog darkened the day.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on guiyou: great fog; day turned dark.

units.zh: 七年九月庚辰，地震。
units.en: Seventh year, ninth month, on gengchen: earthquake.
units.literal: Seventh year, ninth month, on gengchen: earthquake.

units.zh: 八月五月甲子，北望澱大風，雨雹，廣十里，長六十里。
units.en: Eighth year, fifth month, on jiazi: at Bei Wangdian marsh a great wind brought hail ten li wide and sixty li long.
units.literal: Eighth year, fifth month, on jiazi: at Bei Wangdian marsh a great wind; hail fell over ten li wide and sixty li long.

units.zh: 六月，河決李固渡，水入曹州。
units.en: Sixth month: the Yellow River broke at Ligudu crossing and water entered Cao Prefecture.
units.literal: Sixth month: the Yellow River broke at Ligudu crossing; water entered Cao Prefecture.

units.zh: 十年正月，鄧州進芝草。
units.en: Tenth year, first month: Deng Prefecture presented lingzhi.
units.literal: Tenth year, first month: Deng Prefecture presented lingzhi.

units.zh: 十一年六月戊申，西南路招討司苾裏海水之地雨雹三十餘裏，小者如雞卵，其一最大，廣三尺，長太餘，四五日始消。
units.en: Eleventh year, sixth month, on wushen: at the Bilhi River in Southwest Route Pacification Commission territory hail fell over more than thirty li; the small were like hen's eggs, the largest three feet wide and more than a zhang long; four or five days passed before it melted.
units.literal: Eleventh year, sixth month, on wushen: at the Bilhi River in the Southwest Route Pacification Commission territory hail fell over more than thirty li; the small were like hen's eggs, the largest three feet wide and more than a zhang long; four or five days before it melted.

units.zh: 十二年三月庚寅，雨土。
units.en: Twelfth year, third month, on gengyin: rain of earth.
units.literal: Twelfth year, third month, on gengyin: rain of earth.

units.zh: 四月，旱。
units.en: Fourth month: drought.
units.literal: Fourth month: drought.

units.zh: 十三年正月，尚書省奏：「宛平張孝善有子曰合得，大定十二年三月旦以疾死，至暮復活，雲是本良鄉人王建子喜兒。
units.en: Thirteenth year, first month, the Ministry of the Masters of Writing memorialized: "Zhang Xiaoshan of Wanping had a son named Hede; on the morning of the third month of Dading twelfth year he died of illness, but at dusk revived, saying he was Xi’er, son of Wang Jian of Liangxiang.
units.literal: Thirteenth year, first month, the Ministry of the Masters of Writing memorialized: "Zhang Xiaoshan of Wanping had a son named Hede; on the morning of the third month of Dading twelfth year he died of illness, but at dusk revived, saying he was Xi’er, son of Wang Jian of Liangxiang.

units.zh: 而喜兒前三年已死，建驗以家事，能具道之。
units.en: Yet Xi'er had died three years before; Wang Jian tested him with household affairs and he could recount them in full.
units.literal: Yet Xi'er had died three years before; Wang Jian tested him with household affairs and he could recount them in full.

units.zh: 此蓋假屍還魂，擬付王建為子。」
units.en: This is likely a borrowed corpse returning with a soul; it is proposed to assign him to Wang Jian as son."
units.literal: This is likely a borrowed corpse returning with a soul; it is proposed to assign him to Wang Jian as son."

units.zh: 上曰：「若是則奸幸小人競生詐偽，瀆亂人倫。」
units.en: The emperor said: "If so, crafty villains will vie to commit fraud and profane human relations."
units.literal: The emperor said: "If so, crafty villains will vie to commit fraud and profane human relations."

units.zh: 止付孝善。
units.en: He ordered him left with Xiaoshan.
units.literal: He ordered him left with Xiaoshan.

units.zh: 八月丁丑，策試進士于憫忠寺，夜半忽聞音樂聲起東塔上，西達于宮。
units.en: Eighth month, on dingchou: the jinshi examination was held at Mianzhong Temple; at midnight music suddenly sounded, rising from the east pagoda and reaching west to the palace.
units.literal: Eighth month, on dingchou: the jinshi examination was held at Mianzhong Temple; at midnight music suddenly sounded, rising from the east pagoda and reaching west to the palace.

units.zh: 考官完顏蒲捏、李晏等以為文運始開，得賢之兆。
units.en: Examiners Wanyan Punie, Li Yan, and others took it as literary fortune opening and an omen of obtaining worthy men.
units.literal: Examiners Wanyan Punie, Li Yan, and others took it as literary fortune opening and an omen of obtaining the worthy.

units.zh: 十四年八月丁巳朔，次颭裏舌，是午，白龍見於禦帳之東小港中，既乘臨雷雲而上，尾猶曳地，良久北去。
units.en: Fourteenth year, eighth month, new moon on dingsi, halting at Cifali She: at noon a white dragon appeared in a small creek east of the imperial tent; it then rode up on thunder-clouds, its tail still trailing the ground, and after long went north.
units.literal: Fourteenth year, eighth month, new moon on dingsi, halting at Cifali She: at noon a white dragon appeared in a small creek east of the imperial tent; it then rode up on thunder-clouds, its tail still trailing the ground, and after long went north.

units.zh: 十六年三月戊申，雨豆於臨潢之境，其形上銳而赤，食之味頗苦。
units.en: Sixteenth year, third month, on wushen: beans rained in the Linhuang region; they were sharp above and red, and tasted rather bitter when eaten.
units.literal: Sixteenth year, third month, on wushen: beans rained in the Linhuang region; their shape was sharp above and red; eaten, the taste was rather bitter.

units.zh: 五月戊申，南京宮殿火。
units.en: Fifth month, on wushen: fire at the Nanjing palace halls.
units.literal: Fifth month, on wushen: fire at the Nanjing palace halls.

units.zh: 日歲，中都、河北、山東、陝西、河東、遼東等十路旱、蝗。
units.en: That year drought and locusts afflicted the Central Capital, Hebei, Shandong, Shaanxi, Hedong, Liaodong, and the like among ten circuits.
units.literal: That year: drought and locusts in the Central Capital, Hebei, Shandong, Shaanxi, Hedong, Liaodong, and the like among ten circuits.

units.zh: 十七年七月，大雨，滹沱、盧溝水溢，河決白溝。
units.en: Seventeenth year, seventh month: great rain; the Hutuo and Lugou rivers overflowed and the Yellow River broke at Baigou.
units.literal: Seventeenth year, seventh month: great rain; the Hutuo and Lugou rivers overflowed; the Yellow River broke at Baigou.

units.zh: 二十年四月己亥，太甯宮門火。
units.en: Twentieth year, fourth month, on jihai: fire at the gate of Taining Palace.
units.literal: Twentieth year, fourth month, on jihai: fire at the gate of Taining Palace.

units.zh: 五月丙寅，京師地震，生黑白毛。
units.en: In the fifth month, on bingyin, the capital was shaken by an earthquake and black and white hair sprouted from the ground.
units.literal: Fifth month, bingyin: the capital earthquake; black and white hair grew.

units.zh: 七月，旱。
units.en: In the seventh month there was drought.
units.literal: Seventh month: drought.

units.zh: 秋，河決衛州。
units.en: In autumn the Yellow River burst its banks at Weizhou.
units.literal: Autumn: the Yellow River broke its banks at Weizhou.

units.zh: 二十二年五月，慶都蝗蝝生，散漫十餘裏。
units.en: In the twenty-second year, fifth month, locust nymphs appeared at Qingdu and spread over more than ten li.
units.literal: Twenty-second year, fifth month: at Qingdu locust nymphs appeared, scattered over more than ten li.

units.zh: 一夕大風，蝗皆不見。
units.en: One night a great wind rose and every locust disappeared.
units.literal: One night a great wind blew and the locusts all vanished.

units.zh: 二十三年正月辛巳，廣樂園燈山焚，延及熙春殿。
units.en: In the twenty-third year, first month, on xinsi, the lamp mountain of the Broad Music Garden caught fire and the blaze reached the Halcyon Spring Hall.
units.literal: Twenty-third year, first month, xinsi: the lamp mountain of the Broad Music Garden burned, spreading to the Halcyon Spring Hall.

units.zh: 三月乙酉，氛埃雨土。
units.en: In the third month, on yiyou, dusty haze filled the air and earth rained down.
units.literal: Third month, yiyou: dusty haze and rain of earth.

units.zh: 四月庚子亦如之。
units.en: In the fourth month, on gengzi, the same occurred again.
units.literal: Fourth month, gengzi: it was likewise again.

units.zh: 五月丁亥，雨雹，地生白毛。
units.en: In the fifth month, on dinghai, hail fell and white hair sprouted from the ground.
units.literal: Fifth month, dinghai: hail fell and white hair grew from the ground.

units.zh: 二十四年正月辛卯朔，徐州進芝十有八莖。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year, first month, on the xinmao new moon, Xuzhou presented eighteen stalks of lingzhi.
units.literal: Twenty-fourth year, first month, xinmao new moon: Xuzhou presented lingzhi in eighteen stalks.

units.zh: 真定嘉禾二本，異畝同穎。
units.en: At Zhending two stalks of auspicious grain grew, in separate fields yet sharing one ear.
units.literal: At Zhending two stalks of auspicious grain, different fields but one ear.

units.zh: 二十六年正月庚辰，河南府進芝三本。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year, first month, on gengchen, Henan Prefecture presented three stalks of lingzhi.
units.literal: Twenty-sixth year, first month, gengchen: Henan Prefecture presented lingzhi in three stalks.

units.zh: 秋，河決，壞衛州城。
units.en: In autumn the Yellow River burst its banks and wrecked Weizhou city.
units.literal: Autumn: the Yellow River broke its banks and destroyed Weizhou city.

units.zh: 二十七年四月辛丑，京師地微震。
units.en: In the twenty-seventh year, fourth month, on xinchou, the capital was lightly shaken.
units.literal: Twenty-seventh year, fourth month, xinchou: the capital was slightly shaken.

units.zh: 章宗大定二十九年五月丁未，地生白毛。
units.en: In Zhangzong’s twenty-ninth year of Dading, fifth month, on dingwei, white hair sprouted from the ground.
units.literal: Zhangzong, twenty-ninth year of Dading, fifth month, dingwei: white hair grew from the ground.

units.zh: 五月，曹州河溢。
units.en: In the fifth month the Yellow River overflowed at Caozhou.
units.literal: Fifth month: the Yellow River overflowed at Caozhou.

units.zh: 十二月，密州進白鶉、白雉各一。
units.en: In the twelfth month Mizhou presented one white quail and one white pheasant.
units.literal: Twelfth month: Mizhou presented one white quail and one white pheasant.

units.zh: 河間府進嘉禾。
units.en: Hejian Prefecture presented auspicious grain.
units.literal: Hejian Prefecture presented auspicious grain.

units.zh: 日冬無雪。
units.en: That winter brought no snow.
units.literal: That winter there was no snow.

units.zh: 明昌元年正月，懷州、河間等處進芝草、嘉禾。
units.en: In the first year of Mingchang, first month, Huai Prefecture, Hejian, and other districts presented lingzhi and auspicious grain.
units.literal: Mingchang first year, first month: Huai Prefecture, Hejian, and other places presented lingzhi grass and auspicious grain.

units.zh: 二月，地生白毛。
units.en: In the second month white hair sprouted from the ground.
units.literal: Second month: white hair grew from the ground.

units.zh: 六月庚子，都水進異卵。
units.en: In the sixth month, on gengzi, the Directorate of Waterways presented strange eggs.
units.literal: Sixth month, gengzi: the Directorate of Waterways presented strange eggs.

units.zh: 夏，旱。
units.en: That summer there was drought.
units.literal: Summer: drought.

units.zh: 七月，淫雨傷稼。
units.en: In the seventh month prolonged rain damaged the crops.
units.literal: Seventh month: prolonged rain damaged the crops.

units.zh: 二年五月，桓、撫等州旱。
units.en: In the second year, fifth month, Huan and Fu prefectures suffered drought.
units.literal: Second year, fifth month: Huan and Fu prefectures suffered drought.

units.zh: 秋，山東、河北旱，饑。
units.en: In autumn Shandong and Hebei suffered drought and famine.
units.literal: Autumn: Shandong and Hebei suffered drought and famine.

units.zh: 三年秋，綏德虸蚄蟲生，旱。
units.en: In the third year, autumn, caterpillar worms appeared at Suide and drought followed.
units.literal: Third year, autumn: at Suide caterpillar worms appeared and there was drought.

units.zh: 四年三月，御史中丞董師中奏：「乃者太白晝見，京師地震，北方有赤氣，遲明始散。
units.en: In the fourth year, third month, Vice Censor-in-Chief Dong Shizhong memorialized: "Lately Venus has shown in daytime, the capital has been shaken by earthquake, and red vapor in the north lingered until dawn was far advanced.
units.literal: Fourth year, third month: Vice Censor-in-Chief Dong Shizhong memorialized: "Of late Venus appeared in daytime, the capital was shaken by earthquake, and in the north there was red vapor that did not disperse until dawn was well advanced.

units.zh: 天之示象，冀有以警悟聖主也。」
units.en: Heaven’s signs are meant, I trust, to awaken the sage ruler."
units.literal: Heaven’s display of signs is meant, I trust, to awaken the sage ruler."

units.zh: 上問：「所言天象何從得之？」
units.en: The emperor asked, "How did you learn of these celestial signs?"
units.literal: The emperor asked: "From whom did you learn these celestial signs?"

units.zh: 師中曰：「前監察御史陳元升得之于一司天長行。」
units.en: Shizhong said, "Former Investigating Censor Chen Yuansheng heard them from a senior clerk of the Directorate of Astronomy."
units.literal: Shizhong said: "Former Investigating Censor Chen Yuansheng learned them from a senior clerk of the Directorate of Astronomy."

units.zh: 上曰：「司天臺官不奏固有罪，其以語人尤非。
units.en: The emperor said, "Directorate officials are surely guilty for not reporting, but spreading word to others is especially wrong.
units.literal: The emperor said: "Directorate of Astronomy officials are surely guilty for not reporting, but telling others is especially wrong.

units.zh: 朕欲令自今司天有事而不奏者長行得言之，何如？」
units.en: I wish that hereafter when the Directorate has a matter and does not report it, senior clerks may speak up—what do you think?"
units.literal: I wish that hereafter when the Directorate has a matter and does not report it, senior clerks may speak of it—what do you think?"

units.zh: 師中曰：「善。」
units.en: Shizhong said, "Good."
units.literal: Shizhong said: "Good."

units.zh: 五月，霖雨，命有司祈晴。
units.en: In the fifth month prolonged rain fell and officials were ordered to pray for clear skies.
units.literal: Fifth month: prolonged rain; officials were ordered to pray for clear weather.

units.zh: 六月，河決衛州，魏、清、滄皆被害。
units.en: In the sixth month the Yellow River burst at Weizhou and Wei, Qing, and Cang were all harmed.
units.literal: Sixth month: the Yellow River broke its banks at Weizhou; Wei, Qing, and Cang were all harmed.

units.zh: 是歲，河北、山東、南京、陝西諸路大稔。
units.en: That year Hebei, Shandong, Nanjing, and Shaanxi circuits all enjoyed a great harvest.
units.literal: That year Hebei, Shandong, Nanjing, and Shaanxi circuits all had a great harvest.

units.zh: 邢、洺、深、冀及河北西路十六謀克之地，野蠶成繭。
units.en: Across the sixteen meng’an districts of Xing, Ming, Shen, Ji, and Hebei West Circuit, wild silkworms spun cocoons.
units.literal: In the sixteen meng’an districts of Xing, Ming, Shen, Ji, and the Hebei West Circuit, wild silkworms formed cocoons.

units.zh: 十一月壬午，木冰。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on renwu, trees were coated with glaze ice.
units.literal: Eleventh month, renwu: tree glaze.

units.zh: 五年七月丙戌，天壽節，先陰雨連日，至是開霽，有龍曳尾於殿前雲間。
units.en: In the fifth year, seventh month, on bingxu, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: rain and cloud had lasted for days, but that day the sky cleared and a dragon dragged its tail through the clouds before the hall.
units.literal: Fifth year, seventh month, bingxu: the Heavenly Longevity Festival; rain and overcast had continued for days, but on this day the sky cleared, and a dragon trailed its tail through the clouds before the hall.

units.zh: 八月，河決陽武故堤，灌封丘而東。
units.en: In the eighth month the Yellow River breached the old embankment at Yangwu and poured east past Fengqiu.
units.literal: Eighth month: the Yellow River broke the old embankment at Yangwu and flooded east past Fengqiu.

units.zh: 六年二月丁丑，京師地震，大雨雹，晝晦，大風，震應天門左鴟尾壞。
units.en: In the sixth year, second month, on dingchou, the capital was shaken by earthquake; great hail fell; daylight was dimmed; a great wind blew and broke the left owl-tail ornament on the Gate of Responding to Heaven.
units.literal: Sixth year, second month, dingchou: the capital was shaken by earthquake; great hail fell; the day was darkened; a great wind blew and the owl-tail ornament on the left of the Gate of Responding to Heaven was broken.

units.zh: 六年八月，大雨震電，有龍起於渾儀鰲趺，台忽中裂而摧。
units.en: In the sixth year, eighth month, heavy rain, thunder, and lightning struck; a dragon rose from the tortoise pedestal of the armillary sphere; the terrace suddenly split and collapsed.
units.literal: Sixth year, eighth month: great rain, thunder, and lightning; a dragon rose from the tortoise pedestal of the armillary sphere; the terrace suddenly split down the middle and collapsed.

units.zh: 儀僕於台下。
units.en: The instrument fell beneath the terrace.
units.literal: The instrument fell below the terrace.

units.zh: 承安元年五月，自正月不雨，至是月雨。
units.en: In the first year of Cheng’an, fifth month, rain finally fell after none had fallen since the first month.
units.literal: In the first year of Cheng’an, fifth month, it had not rained since the first month; in this month rain fell.

units.zh: 六月，平晉縣民利通家蠶自成綿段，長七尺一寸五分，闊四尺九寸。
units.en: In the sixth month, in the household of Li Tong of Pingjin County, silkworms formed a bolt of floss by themselves, seven chi one cun and five fen long and four chi nine cun wide.
units.literal: In the sixth month, at the house of the commoner Li Tong in Pingjin County, silkworms formed a piece of floss by themselves, seven chi one cun and five fen long and four chi nine cun wide.

units.zh: 二年，自正月至四月不雨。
units.en: In the second year, no rain fell from the first through the fourth month.
units.literal: In the second year, from the first month through the fourth month it did not rain.

units.zh: 六月丙午，雨雹。
units.en: In the sixth month, on bingwu, hail fell.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on bingwu, hail fell.

units.zh: 四年三月戊午，雨雹。
units.en: In the fourth year, third month, on wuwu, hail fell.
units.literal: In the fourth year, third month, on wuwu, hail fell.

units.zh: 五月，旱。
units.en: In the fifth month there was drought.
units.literal: In the fifth month, there was drought.

units.zh: 五年五月庚辰，地震。
units.en: In the fifth year, fifth month, on gengchen, the earth shook.
units.literal: In the fifth year, fifth month, on gengchen, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 十月庚子，天久陰，是日雲色黃而風霾。
units.en: In the tenth month, on gengzi, after long overcast skies, the clouds turned yellow and wind brought haze.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on gengzi, the sky had long been overcast; that day the clouds were yellow and wind brought haze.

units.zh: 癸卯晨，陰霜附木，至日入亦如之。
units.en: On guimao morning, dark frost clung to the trees and remained so until sunset.
units.literal: On guimao morning, dark frost clung to trees; by sunset it was still the same.

units.zh: 泰和二年八月丙申，磁州武安縣鼓山石聖台，有大鳥十集於臺上，其羽五色爛然，文多赤黃，赭冠雞項，尾闊而修，狀若鯉魚尾而長，高可逾人，九子差小侍傍，亦高四五尺。
units.en: In the second year of Taihe, eighth month, on bingshen, at the Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers shone in five colors, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long like a carp’s tail and taller than a man; nine smaller young stood beside them, each four or five chi high.
units.literal: Taihe second year, eighth month, bingshen: at the Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers were brilliantly five-colored, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long, shaped like a carp’s tail and tall enough to surpass a man; nine young somewhat smaller attended at the side, likewise four or five chi in height.

units.zh: 禽鳥萬數形色各異，或飛或蹲，或步或立，皆成行列，首皆正向如朝拱然。
units.en: Myriad birds of every shape and color flew or crouched, walked or stood, all in ranks facing forward as if bowing in court.
units.literal: Myriad birds of every shape and color either flew or crouched, walked or stood, all in ranks with their heads turned forward as if bowing in court.

units.zh: 初自東南來，勢如連雲，聲如殷雷，林木震動，牧者驚惶，即驅牛擊物以驚之，殊不為動。
units.en: At first they came from the southeast like linked clouds, roaring like thunder; trees shook; herdsmen panicked and drove cattle and struck things to scare them, yet the birds did not stir.
units.literal: At first they came from the southeast like linked clouds, sounding like rolling thunder; trees shook; herdsmen were terrified and drove cattle and struck objects to scare them, yet they did not stir at all.

units.zh: 俄有大鳥如雕鶚者怒來搏擊之，民益恐，奔告縣官，皆以為鳳凰也，命工圖上之。
units.en: Soon a great bird like an eagle came furiously to strike them; the people grew more afraid and reported to the county, where all called them phoenixes and ordered artisans to paint them and submit the pictures.
units.literal: Soon a great bird like an eagle came angrily to strike them; the people grew more afraid and ran to tell the county officials, who all took them for phoenixes and ordered artisans to paint them and submit the pictures.

units.zh: 留二日西北去。
units.en: After two days they departed to the northwest.
units.literal: After two days they went off to the northwest.

units.zh: 按視其處，糞跡數頃，其色各異。
units.en: On inspecting the site, droppings covered several qing, each of a different color.
units.literal: On inspecting the place, droppings covered several qing, each of a different color.

units.zh: 遺禽數千，累日不能去。
units.en: Thousands of birds lingered and would not depart for many days.
units.literal: Thousands of birds remained behind; for many days they would not leave.

units.zh: 所食皆巨鯉，大者丈餘，魚骨蔽地。
units.en: They fed on giant carp, some more than ten chi long, until fish bones carpeted the ground.
units.literal: What they ate were all giant carp; the largest were more than ten chi; fish bones covered the ground.

units.zh: 章宗以其事告宗廟，詔中外。
units.en: Zhangzong reported the affair to the ancestral temple and proclaimed it throughout court and realm.
units.literal: Zhangzong reported the matter to the ancestral temple and issued an edict to the court and the realm.

units.zh: 三年四月，旱。
units.en: In the third year, fourth month, there was drought.
units.literal: Year 3, fourth month: drought.

units.zh: 十月己亥，大風。
units.en: In the tenth month, on jihai, a great wind rose.
units.literal: Tenth month, on jihai: a great wind.

units.zh: 四年正月壬申，陰霧，木冰。
units.en: In the fourth year, first month, on renshen, gloom hung low and tree ice formed.
units.literal: Year 4, first month, on renshen: overcast gloom; tree ice.

units.zh: 三月丁卯，大風，毀宣陽門鴟尾。
units.en: In the third month, on dingmao, a great wind broke the owl-tail finial of Xuanyang Gate.
units.literal: Third month, on dingmao: a great wind destroyed the owl-tail finial of Xuanyang Gate.

units.zh: 四月，旱。
units.en: In the fourth month there was drought.
units.literal: Fourth month: drought.

units.zh: 壬戌，萬甯宮端門災。
units.en: On renxu fire struck the main gate of Wanning Palace.
units.literal: On renxu the main gate of Wanning Palace caught fire.

units.zh: 十一月丁卯，陰。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, the sky stayed overcast.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on dingmao: overcast.

units.zh: 木冰凡三日。
units.en: Tree ice lasted three days altogether.
units.literal: Tree ice lasted three days in all.

units.zh: 五年夏，旱。
units.en: In the fifth year, summer brought drought.
units.literal: Fifth year, summer: drought.

units.zh: 八年閏四月甲午，雨雹。
units.en: In the eighth year, intercalary fourth month, on jiawu, hail fell.
units.literal: Eighth year, intercalary fourth month, on jiawu: hail fell.

units.zh: 河南路蝗。
units.en: Locusts appeared in Henan Circuit.
units.literal: Henan Circuit had locusts.

units.zh: 六月戊子，飛蝗入京畿。
units.en: In the sixth month, on wuzi, flying locusts entered the capital region.
units.literal: Sixth month, on wuzi: flying locusts entered the capital region.

units.zh: 八月乙酉，有虎至陽春門外，駕出射獲之。
units.en: In the eighth month, on yiyou, a tiger reached the outside of Yangchun Gate; the emperor went out, shot it, and killed it.
units.literal: Eighth month, on yiyou: a tiger came to the outside of Yangchun Gate; the emperor went out and shot and obtained it.

units.zh: 時又有童謠雲：「易水流，汴水流，更年易過又休休。
units.en: At the time a children’s ballad ran: "The Yishui flows, the Bian flows; the years turn easily and all grows still.
units.literal: At the time there was also a children’s ballad that said: "The Yishui flows, the Bian River flows; years pass easily and all is at rest.

units.zh: 兩家都好住，前後總成留。」
units.en: Both homes may settle well; before and after all comes to stay."
units.literal: Both households may dwell well; before and after all becomes liu."

units.zh: 至貞*中，舉國遷汴。
units.en: In the Zhenyou era the entire realm relocated to Bian.
units.literal: By the Zhenyou era the whole state moved to Bian.

units.zh: 衛紹王大安元年，徐、邳界黃河清五百餘裏，幾二年，以其事詔中外。
units.en: In King Shao of Wei's first Da'an year the Yellow River ran clear along the Xu–Pi border for more than five hundred li for nearly two years, and an edict proclaimed it throughout court and realm.
units.literal: King Shao of Wei, Da'an year 1: along the Xu and Pi border the Yellow River ran clear for more than five hundred li, nearly two years; an edict on the matter was sent to court and realm.

units.zh: 臨洮人楊珪上書曰：「河性本濁，而今反清，是水失其性也。
units.en: Yang Gui of Lintao memorialized: "The Yellow River is naturally muddy; that it has turned clear means the water has lost its true nature.
units.literal: Yang Gui of Lintao submitted a memorial saying: "The river’s nature is turbid, yet now it has turned clear; the water has lost its nature.

units.zh: 正猶天動地靜，使當動者靜，當靜者動，則如之何，其為災異明矣。
units.en: It is like heaven stirring and earth resting: if what must move is stilled and what must rest is stirred, how can order hold? The omen of calamity is plain.
units.literal: It is just as when heaven should move and earth should be still — if what should move is made still and what should be still is made to move, what then can be done? The thing is plainly a portent of disaster.

units.zh: 且《傳》曰：'黃河青，聖人生。
units.en: Moreover tradition says, “When the Yellow River turns green, a sage is born.”
units.literal: Moreover the Tradition says, “When the Yellow River turns green, a sage is born.”

units.zh: '假使聖人生，恐不在今日。
units.en: Even if a sage were born, he would hardly appear in our own time.
units.literal: Even if a sage were born, he is unlikely to appear in our day.

units.zh: 又曰'黃河清，諸侯為天子。
units.en: It also says, “When the Yellow River clears, lords become Son of Heaven.”
units.literal: It also says, “When the Yellow River clears, feudal lords become Son of Heaven.”

units.zh: '正當戒懼，以銷災變，而複誇示四方，臣所未喻。」
units.en: The court ought to be wary and dispel the portent, not boast of it to the four quarters; this your subject cannot fathom."
units.literal: One ought rather to be vigilant and dispel the omen, yet instead it is displayed to the four quarters; this your subject cannot understand."

units.zh: 宰相以為妖言，議誅之，慮絕言路，即詔大興鎖銷還本管。
units.en: The chancellors called it demonic speech and debated execution, yet fearing to choke off remonstrance they issued an edict to Daxing to detain him in irons and return him to his home circuit.
units.literal: The chancellors deemed it demon talk and discussed putting him to death, but fearing to cut off the path of remonstrance they instead issued an edict to Daxing to lock and escort him back to his native circuit.

units.zh: 十一月丙申，平陽地震，有聲自西北來。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, Pingyang quaked and a rumble rolled in from the northwest.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen: Pingyang earthquake; a sound came from the northwest.

units.zh: 戊戌夜，又震，自此時複震動，浮山縣尤劇，城廨民居圮者十七八，死者凡二三千人。
units.en: On wuxu night it shook again, and tremors kept returning, worst in Fushan county: seven or eight dwellings in ten were ruined, and two or three thousand people died.
units.literal: On wuxu night it shook again; from then on tremors recurred, worst in Fushan county — seventeen or eighteen out of ten city offices and private dwellings collapsed, and the dead numbered two or three thousand in all.

units.zh: 二年二月乙酉，地大震，有聲殷殷然。
units.en: In the second year, second month, on yiyou, a great earthquake rumbled deep and long.
units.literal: Year 2, second month, on yiyou: a great earthquake; the sound was deep and rolling.

units.zh: 六月、七月至九月晦。
units.en: From the sixth and seventh months until the ninth month's last day.
units.literal: From the sixth and seventh months until the end of the ninth.

units.zh: 其震不一。
units.en: The tremors did not come alike.
units.literal: The shocks were not uniform.

units.zh: 十一月，京師民周修武宅前渠內火出，高二尺，焚其板橋。
units.en: In the eleventh month fire erupted from the canal ditch before Zhou Xiuwu's house in the capital, rose two chi, and burned his plank bridge.
units.literal: Eleventh month: before the house of the capital resident Zhou Xiuwu, fire burst from the canal ditch two chi high and burned his plank bridge.

units.zh: 又旬日，大悲閣幡竿下石隙中火出，高二三尺，人近之即滅，凡十餘日。
units.en: Ten days later fire shot from a stone crack under the banner pole at Great Compassion Pavilion, two or three chi high; anyone who neared it saw the flame die — for more than ten days.
units.literal: Ten days later fire burst from a stone crevice beneath the banner pole at Great Compassion Pavilion, two or three chi high; when people drew near it went out — this lasted more than ten days.

units.zh: 自是都城連夜燔爇二三十處。
units.en: After that the capital burned in twenty or thirty places each night.
units.literal: From then on the capital burned in twenty or thirty places every night.

units.zh: 是歲四月，山東、河北大旱，至六月，雨複不止，民間斗米至千余錢。
units.en: That year, fourth month, Shandong and Hebei suffered severe drought; by the sixth month rain would not cease, and grain in the markets reached more than a thousand cash per dou.
units.literal: That year, fourth month: Shandong and Hebei suffered great drought; by the sixth month rain would not stop, and in the markets a dou of grain reached more than a thousand cash.

units.zh: 三年二月乙亥夜，大風從西北來，髮屋折木，吹清夷門關折。
units.en: In the third year, second month, on yihai night, a great wind from the northwest stripped roofs, snapped trees, and broke Qingyi Gate's bar.
units.literal: Year 3, second month, on yihai night: a great wind came from the northwest, tore off roofs and snapped trees, and blew Qingyi Gate's bar broken.

units.zh: 三月戊午，大悲閣災，延燒萬餘家，火五日不絕。
units.en: In the third month, on wuwu, fire took Great Compassion Pavilion and spread through more than ten thousand households; the flames burned five days without end.
units.literal: Third month, on wuwu: Great Compassion Pavilion caught fire; the blaze spread through more than ten thousand households and the fire did not die for five days.

units.zh: 山東、河北、河東諸路大旱。
units.en: Shandong, Hebei, and Hedong circuits suffered severe drought.
units.literal: Shandong, Hebei, and Hedong circuits suffered great drought.

units.zh: 是歲，有男子郝贊詣省言：「上即位之後，天變屢見，火焚萬家，風折門關，非小異也，宜退位讓有德。」
units.en: That year a man named Hao Zan came to the Secretariat and said: "Since Your Majesty ascended the throne heaven’s warnings have piled up; fire consumed ten thousand homes, wind broke a gate bar; these are no trifling signs. You should abdicate to one of virtue."
units.literal: That year a man named Hao Zan came to the Secretariat and said: "Since Your Majesty took the throne, heaven’s warnings have come again and again; fire burned ten thousand homes, wind broke a gate bar; these are no small portents. You ought to abdicate in favor of one who has virtue."

units.zh: 有司問：「爾狂疾乎？」
units.en: The offices asked: "Are you mad?"
units.literal: The responsible offices asked: "Are you mad?"

units.zh: 贊大言曰：「我不狂疾，但為社稷計，宰相皆非其才。」
units.en: Zan cried out: "I am not mad; I speak for the realm; not one chancellor is fit for his post."
units.literal: Zan spoke loudly: "I am not mad; I speak only for the altars of state; the chancellors are none of them fit for their posts."

units.zh: 每日省前大呼，凡半月。
units.en: Each day he shouted before the Secretariat; this lasted half a month.
units.literal: Each day he shouted before the Secretariat; this went on half a month.

units.zh: 上怒，誅之隱處。
units.en: The emperor was furious and had him put to death in secret.
units.literal: The emperor was enraged and had him executed in secret.

units.zh: 崇慶元年七月辛未未時，有風從東來，吹帛一段高數十丈，宛轉如龍，墜於拱辰門內。
units.en: Chongqing 1, seventh month, on xinwei at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind from the east lifted a bolt of silk dozens of zhang high, coiled it like a dragon, and dropped it inside Gongchen Gate.
units.literal: Chongqing year 1, seventh month, on xinwei at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind came from the east and blew a length of silk dozens of zhang high; it twisted like a dragon and fell inside Gongchen Gate.

units.zh: 是歲，河東、陝西、南京諸路旱。
units.en: That year Hedong, Shaanxi, and the Southern Capital circuit suffered drought.
units.literal: That year Hedong, Shaanxi, and Southern Capital circuits suffered drought.

units.zh: 二年二月，放進士榜，有狂僧公言：「殺天子。」
units.en: In the second year, second month, when the jinshi list was posted, a mad monk shouted: "Kill the Son of Heaven!"
units.literal: Year 2, second month: when the jinshi list was released, a mad monk cried aloud: "Kill the Son of Heaven!"

units.zh: 求之不知所在。
units.en: They searched for him but could not find where he had gone.
units.literal: A search was made but he could not be found.

units.zh: 是歲，河東、陝西大旱，京兆斗米至八千錢。
units.en: That year Hedong and Shaanxi suffered severe drought; in Jingzhao a dou of grain cost eight thousand cash.
units.literal: That year Hedong and Shaanxi suffered great drought; in Jingzhao a dou of grain reached eight thousand cash.

units.zh: 至寧元年，宣宗彰德故園竹開白花，如鷺鷥藤。
units.en: In the first year of Zhining, bamboo in Xuanzong’s old garden at Zhangde bloomed with white flowers like egrets’ vine.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhining, in Xuanzong’s old garden at Zhangde, bamboo opened white flowers like egrets’ vine.

units.zh: 紫雲覆城上數日，俄而入繼大統。
units.en: Purple clouds covered the city for several days; soon afterward he entered and inherited the throne.
units.literal: Purple clouds covered the city for several days, and soon he entered to inherit the great succession.

units.zh: 七月，以河東、陝西諸處旱，遣工部尚書高朵剌祈雨於岩瀆，至是雨足。
units.en: In the seventh month, because Hedong, Shaanxi, and other places suffered drought, Minister of Works Gao Duola was sent to pray for rain at Yandu, and by then enough rain had fallen.
units.literal: In the seventh month, because Hedong, Shaanxi, and various places suffered drought, Minister of Works Gao Duola was sent to pray for rain at Yandu; by this time the rain was sufficient.

units.zh: 時斗米有至錢萬二千者。
units.en: At the time a dou of grain could cost as much as twelve thousand cash.
units.literal: At the time a dou of grain reached as much as twelve thousand cash.

units.zh: 八月癸巳，衛紹王遇弑。
units.en: In the eighth month, on guisi day, King Shao of Wei was assassinated.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on guisi day, King Shao of Wei was assassinated.

units.zh: 是日，海水不潮，寶坻鹽司懼其虧課，致禱無應。
units.en: That day the sea did not tide; the Baodi Salt Office feared a shortfall in its quota, but its prayers brought no response.
units.literal: That day the seawater did not tide; the Baodi Salt Office feared it would fall short of its quota, and though it prayed there was no response.

units.zh: 九月丙午，宣宗即位乃潮。
units.en: In the ninth month, on bingwu, when Xuanzong ascended the throne, the tide returned.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on bingwu, when Xuanzong took the throne, it then tided.

units.zh: 初，衛王即位改元大安，四年改曰崇慶，即而又改曰至寧，有人謂曰：「三元大崇至矣。」
units.en: At first, when the Prince of Wei took the throne, he changed the era name to Da’an; in the fourth year he changed it to Chongqing, and soon changed it again to Zhining. Someone said, "The three eras greatly exalt reaching the end."
units.literal: At first, when the Prince of Wei took the throne, he changed the era name to Da’an; in the fourth year he changed it to Chongqing, and soon afterward changed it again to Zhining. Someone said, "The three eras greatly exalt reaching the end."

units.zh: 俄而有胡沙虎之變。
units.en: Soon afterward came Hushahu’s coup.
units.literal: Soon there was Hushahu’s coup.

units.zh: 宣宗貞祐元年八月戊子夜，將曙，大霧蒼黑，跂步無所見，至辰巳間始散。
units.en: Xuanzong, Zhenyou 1, eighth month, on wuzi night just before dawn: a dense fog, green-black; a man could not see his next step; it did not clear until the chen and si hours.
units.literal: Xuanzong, Zhenyou year 1, eighth month, on wuzi night, just before dawn: a great fog, dark and green-black; one could not see a step ahead; it did not lift until between the chen and si hours.

units.zh: 十二月乙卯，雨，木冰。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on yimao, there was rain and tree ice.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on yimao, rain and tree ice.

units.zh: 時衛州有童謠曰：「團鸑冬，劈半年。
units.en: About then in Weizhou children sang: "Round zuan winter; half a year split apart.
units.literal: At the time in Weizhou there was a children’s rhyme that ran: "Round zuan winter, split half a year.

units.zh: 寒食節，沒人煙。」
units.en: Cold Food Festival; no smoke of human habitation."
units.literal: Cold Food Festival, no human smoke."

units.zh: 明年正月，元兵破衛，遂丘墟矣。
units.en: The following first month Yuan forces stormed Weizhou, and the city was left a wasteland.
units.literal: The next year's first month, Yuan troops broke Weizhou, and it became a mound of ruins.

units.zh: 二年六月，潮白河溢，漂古北口鐵裹關門至老王穀。
units.en: In the second year, sixth month, the Chaobai River burst its banks and washed from Old Northern Pass Iron-Wrapped Barrier Gate to Old King's Valley.
units.literal: Second year, sixth month, the Chaobai River overflowed, sweeping from Old Northern Pass Iron-Wrapped Barrier Gate to Old King's Valley.

units.zh: 庚申，南京寶鎮閣災。
units.en: On gengshen fire broke out at Baozhen Pavilion in the Southern Capital.
units.literal: On gengshen, fire at Southern Capital Baozhen Pavilion.

units.zh: 壬戌，上次宜村，有黃龍見於西北。
units.en: On renxu the emperor was at Yicun when a yellow dragon was seen in the northwest.
units.literal: On renxu, the emperor encamped at Yicun; a yellow dragon appeared in the northwest.

units.zh: 冬，黃河自陝州界至衛州八柳樹，清十餘日，纖鱗皆見。
units.en: That winter the Yellow River from the Shaanzhou frontier to Eight Willows at Weizhou ran clear for over ten days, every fine scale visible.
units.literal: Winter, the Yellow River from Shaanzhou border to Weizhou Eight Willows cleared for more than ten days; fine fish scales were all visible.

units.zh: 十二月己酉，雨，木冰。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, there was rain and tree ice.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jiyou, rain and tree ice.

units.zh: 三年二月戊午，大風，隆德殿鴟尾壞。
units.en: In the third year, on wuwu of the second month, a great wind wrecked the ridge-beast finial of Longde Hall.
units.literal: Third year, second month, on wuwu, great wind; Longde Hall ridge-beast finial damaged.

units.zh: 三月戊辰，大風，霾。
units.en: In the third month, on wuchen, a great wind blew with dusty haze.
units.literal: Third month, on wuchen, great wind and dusty haze.

units.zh: 四月，自去冬不雨，至於是月。
units.en: By the fourth month it had not rained since the previous winter.
units.literal: Fourth month, from last winter no rain until this month.

units.zh: 五月，河南大蝗。
units.en: In the fifth month Henan suffered a great locust plague.
units.literal: Fifth month, great locusts in Henan.

units.zh: 六月，京城中夜妄相驚逐狼，月余方息。
units.en: In the sixth month the capital nightly erupted in false alarms as people chased supposed wolves; the uproar lasted more than a month.
units.literal: Sixth month, in the capital at night people falsely panicked one another chasing wolves; only after more than a month did it cease.

units.zh: 十月丙申，西北有霧氣如積土，至二更乃散。
units.en: Tenth month, on bingshen: northwestern mist piled like earthen ramparts and did not lift until the second watch.
units.literal: Tenth month, on bingshen, in the northwest mist like piled earth; it scattered only at the second watch.

units.zh: 四年正月己未旦，黑霧四塞，巳時乃散，是春，河朔人相食。
units.en: Fourth year, first month, at jiwei dawn black mist walled the horizon and cleared only at si hour; that spring people in Hebei resorted to cannibalism.
units.literal: Fourth year, first month, at jiwei dawn black mist closed on all four sides; it scattered at si hour; that spring people north of the river ate one another.

units.zh: 五月，河南、陝西大蝗。
units.en: In the fifth month Henan and Shaanxi were overrun by locusts.
units.literal: Fifth month, great locusts in Henan and Shaanxi.

units.zh: 鳳翔、扶風、歧山、郿縣騑蟲傷麥。
units.en: At Fengxiang, Fufeng, Qishan, and Mei, fei insects ravaged the wheat.
units.literal: In Fengxiang, Fufeng, Qishan, and Mei counties fei insects damaged the wheat.

units.zh: 七月，旱。
units.en: In the seventh month there was drought.
units.literal: Seventh month, drought.

units.zh: 癸丑，飛蝗過京師。
units.en: On guichou clouds of locusts flew over the capital.
units.literal: On guichou, flying locusts passed over the capital.

units.zh: 興定元年三月，宮中有蝗。
units.en: Xingding 1, third month: locusts appeared within the palace.
units.literal: Xingding year 1, third month, locusts in the palace.

units.zh: 四月，單州雹傷稼。
units.en: In the fourth month hail in Dan Prefecture destroyed the crops.
units.literal: Fourth month, hail at Dan Prefecture damaged the crops.

units.zh: 陳州商水縣進瑞麥，一莖四穗。
units.en: Shangshui County in Chen Prefecture presented auspicious wheat with one stalk bearing four ears.
units.literal: Shangshui County, Chen Prefecture, presented auspicious wheat—one stalk, four ears.

units.zh: 開封府進瑞麥，一莖三穗、二莖四穗。
units.en: Kaifeng prefecture presented auspicious wheat: one stalk with three ears and two stalks with four ears each.
units.literal: Kaifeng prefecture presented auspicious wheat—one stalk with three ears, two stalks with four ears.

units.zh: 五月乙丑，河南大風，吹府門署以去。
units.en: Fifth month, on yichou: a great wind in Henan tore the prefectural gate offices from their places.
units.literal: Fifth month, on yichou, great wind in Henan blew the prefectural gate offices away.

units.zh: 延州原武縣雹傷稼。
units.en: Hail at Yuanwu in Yan Prefecture destroyed the crops.
units.literal: Hail at Yuanwu County, Yan Prefecture damaged the crops.

units.zh: 七月癸卯，大社壇產嘉禾，一莖十五穗。
units.en: Seventh month, on guimao: auspicious grain sprang up at the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain, one stalk with fifteen ears.
units.literal: Seventh month, on guimao, auspicious grain appeared at the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain—one stalk with fifteen ears.

units.zh: 秋，霖雨。
units.en: That autumn brought unending rain.
units.literal: Autumn, prolonged rain.

units.zh: 十月，邠州進白兔。
units.en: In the tenth month Bin Prefecture presented a white hare.
units.literal: Tenth month, Bin Prefecture presented a white hare.

units.zh: 丹州進嘉禾。
units.en: Dan Prefecture presented auspicious grain.
units.literal: Dan Prefecture presented auspicious grain.

units.zh: 異畝同穎。
units.en: Different stalks shared a single ear.
units.literal: Different stalks sharing one ear.

units.zh: 二年四月，河南諸郡蝗。
units.en: Second year, fourth month: locusts struck the Henan prefectures.
units.literal: Second year, fourth month, locusts in the prefectures of Henan.

units.zh: 五月，秦、陝狼害人。
units.en: In the fifth month wolves in Qin and Shaanxi killed people.
units.literal: Fifth month, wolves in Qin and Shaanxi killed people.

units.zh: 六月，旱。
units.en: In the sixth month there was drought.
units.literal: Sixth month, drought.

units.zh: 是歲，京師屢火，遣禮部尚書楊雲翼鋋之。
units.en: That year fires broke out again and again in the capital; Minister of Rites Yang Yunyi was dispatched to perform the halberd-clash rite.
units.literal: That year the capital repeatedly caught fire; Minister of Rites Yang Yunyi was sent to perform the halberd-clash rite against it.

units.zh: 三年春，吏部火。
units.en: Third year, spring: the Ministry of Personnel burned.
units.literal: Third year, spring, fire at the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 四月癸未，陝右黑風晝起，有聲如雷，頃之地大震，平涼、鎮戎、德順尤甚，廬舍傾，壓死者以萬計，雜畜倍之。
units.en: Fourth month, on guiwei: a black wind rose in broad daylight across western Shaanxi, roaring like thunder, then the earth heaved; Pingliang, Zhenrong, and Deshun suffered worst—buildings toppled and the dead ran into the tens of thousands, with livestock losses double that count.
units.literal: Fourth month, on guiwei, a black wind rose by day in western Shaanxi with a sound like thunder; presently the earth quaked greatly; Pingliang, Zhenrong, and Deshun were worst hit—dwellings collapsed and those crushed to death numbered in the tens of thousands, with livestock losses twice that.

units.zh: 夏，旱。
units.en: That summer brought drought.
units.literal: Summer, drought.

units.zh: 十二月壬申，雨，木冰。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on renshen, there was rain and tree ice.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on renshen, rain and tree ice.

units.zh: 四年正月戊辰二更，天鳴有聲。
units.en: Fourth year, first month, at the second watch on wuchen the sky gave forth a sounding voice.
units.literal: Fourth year, first month, at wuchen second watch, the sky sounded with a voice.

units.zh: 壬子，晝晦，有頃大雷風雨。
units.en: On renzi noon turned dark as night; thunder, wind, and rain followed.
units.literal: On renzi, noon went dark; soon great thunder, wind, and rain.

units.zh: 四月丁丑，大風吹河南府署飛百余步，戶案門鑰開，文牘飄散，不知所在。
units.en: Fourth month, on dingchou: a gale hurled the Henan prefectural compound a hundred paces, burst doors and document chests, and scattered papers beyond recovery.
units.literal: Fourth month, on dingchou, a great wind blew the Henan prefectural offices more than a hundred paces; doors, desks, and locks flew open and documents scattered, their whereabouts unknown.

units.zh: 六月，旱。
units.en: In the sixth month there was drought.
units.literal: Sixth month, drought.

units.zh: 七月，河南大水，唐、鄧尤甚。
units.en: In the seventh month Henan flooded; Tang and Deng were hardest hit.
units.literal: Seventh month, great flood in Henan; Tang and Deng suffered especially.

units.zh: 十二月癸酉，火。
units.en: Twelfth month, on guiyou: fire broke out.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on guiyou, fire.

units.zh: 是歲，華州渭南縣民裴德寧家伐樹，破其中有赤色「太」字，表裏吻合。
units.en: That year Pei Dening of Weinan in Huazhou cut down a tree on his property, split it open, and found a red "tai" character within, identical inside and out.
units.literal: That year, when Pei Dening of Weinan County, Huazhou, felled a tree at home, he split it open and found within it a red character "tai", matching inside and out.

units.zh: 有司言與唐大曆中成都瑞木有文「天下太平」者，其事頗同，蓋太平之兆也。
units.en: Officials said it recalled the Tang Dali auspicious tree at Chengdu inscribed "All under Heaven at peace"; much the same sign, likely a portent of great peace.
units.literal: Officials said it recalled the Tang Dali auspicious tree at Chengdu inscribed "All under Heaven at peace"; much the same sign, likely a portent of great peace.

units.zh: 乞付史館。
units.en: They asked that the record be sent to the Historiographical Bureau.
units.literal: They requested it be handed to the Historiographical Bureau.

units.zh: 五年三月，以久旱，詔中外，仍命有司祈禱。
units.en: Fifth year, third month: after long drought an edict went throughout the realm and officials were again ordered to conduct prayers.
units.literal: Fifth year, third month, because of prolonged drought, an edict went to court and countryside, and responsible offices were still ordered to pray.

units.zh: 十一月壬寅，京師相國寺火。
units.en: Eleventh month, on renyin: Xiangguo Temple in the capital burned.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin, fire at Xiangguo Temple in the capital.

units.zh: 十二月丁丑，霜附木。
units.en: Twelfth month, on dingchou: rime frost clung to the trees.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on dingchou, frost adhered to trees.

units.zh: 先是，有童謠雲：「青山轉，轉山青。
units.en: Beforehand children had sung: "Green mountains turn; turn the mountains green.
units.literal: Earlier there had been a children’s rhyme that ran: "Green mountains turn, turn the mountains green.

units.zh: 耽誤盡，少年人。」
units.en: Every delay spent, the young men gone."
units.literal: All delay exhausted, young men."

units.zh: 蓋言是時人皆為兵，轉鬥山谷，戰伐不休，當至老也。
units.en: Men read it as saying that everyone had become a soldier, wheeling through mountain passes in endless war until youth itself was consumed.
units.literal: It meant that then everyone became a soldier, turning and fighting through mountain valleys, warfare unceasing—they would reach old age in it.

units.zh: 元光元年四月，京畿旱。
units.en: the first year of Yuanguang, fourth month: drought struck the capital region.
units.literal: Yuanguang year 1, fourth month, drought in the capital region.

units.zh: 十月，上獵近郊，獲白兔，群臣以為瑞。
units.en: Tenth month: on a suburban hunt the emperor took a white hare, and the ministers hailed it as a lucky sign.
units.literal: Tenth month, the emperor hunted near the suburbs and caught a white hare; the ministers took it as auspicious.

units.zh: 明日，禦便殿，置鈴于項，將縱之，兔驚躍不已，忽斃幾上。
units.en: Next day at the Informal Hall a bell was tied about its neck for release, but the hare panicked and bounded until it dropped dead on the dais.
units.literal: The next day, at the Informal Hall, a bell was hung on its neck and it was to be released; the hare leaped in fright without cease and suddenly died on the table.

units.zh: 二年正月辛酉日午，有鶴千余翔於殿庭，移刻乃去。
units.en: Second year, first month, at xinyou noon a thousand cranes wheeled above the palace court and did not leave for a full quarter-hour.
units.literal: Second year, first month, at xinyou noon, more than a thousand cranes soared over the palace courtyard and departed only after a quarter-hour.

units.zh: 七月乙卯，丹鳳門壞，壓死者數人。
units.en: Seventh month, on yimao: Danfeng Gate gave way and several people were killed.
units.literal: Seventh month, on yimao, Danfeng Gate collapsed; several people were crushed to death.

units.zh: 十一月，開封有虎害人。
units.en: Eleventh month: a tiger at Kaifeng killed people.
units.literal: Eleventh month, a tiger in Kaifeng killed people.

units.zh: 是時屢有妖怪，二年之中，白日虎入鄭門，吏部及宮中有狐狼，鬼夜哭于輦路，烏鵲夜驚，飛鳴蔽天。
units.en: Strange omens piled up: within two years a tiger walked through Zheng Gate in daylight; foxes and wolves haunted the Ministry of Personnel and the inner palace; ghosts wailed along the imperial road at night; crows and magpies exploded into flight until their clamor darkened the sky.
units.literal: At the time strange things recurred; within two years a tiger entered Zheng Gate in broad daylight, foxes and wolves appeared in the Ministry of Personnel and within the palace, ghosts wept at night along the imperial roadway, and crows and magpies startled at night, their cries blotting the sky.

units.zh: 十二月，宣宗崩。
units.en: Twelfth month: Emperor Xuanzong died.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Emperor Xuanzong died.

units.zh: 哀宗正大元年正月戊午，上初視朝，尊太后為仁聖宮皇太后，太元妃為慈聖宮皇太后。
units.en: Aizong, Zhengda 1, first month, on wuwu: the emperor held his first audience, honoring the empress dowager as Empress Dowager of Rensheng Palace and the Grand Consort as Empress Dowager of Cisheng Palace.
units.literal: Aizong, Zhengda year 1, first month, on wuwu, the emperor first held court; the empress dowager was honored as Empress Dowager of Rensheng Palace, the Grand Consort as Empress Dowager of Cisheng Palace.

units.zh: 是日，大風飄端門瓦，昏霾不見日，黃氣塞天，仁聖又夢乞丐萬數踵其後，心惡之，占者曰：「後為天下母，百姓貧窶，將誰訴焉？」
units.en: That day gale winds stripped Duan Gate’s tiles, haze swallowed the sun, and yellow vapor choked the sky; Rensheng dreamed ten thousand beggars at her heels and shuddered; the diviner said: "You are to become mother of the realm; when the people are penniless, whom will they beg?"
units.literal: That day a great wind blew the tiles of Duan Gate; dusty haze hid the sun; yellow vapor filled the sky; Rensheng also dreamed of tens of thousands of beggars treading at her heels and was revolted at heart; the diviner said: "Later you will be mother to all under Heaven; when the people are destitute, to whom will they appeal?"

units.zh: 遂敕京城設粥與冰藥以應之，人以為壬辰、癸巳之兆。
units.en: So the capital was ordered to distribute gruel and cooling draughts in response; people read it as foretelling the disasters of renchen and guisi.
units.literal: An edict was therefore issued to set out gruel and cooling medicine in the capital to answer it; men took this as an omen of the renchen and guisi years.

units.zh: 又有人衣麻衣，望承天門大笑者三，大哭者三，有司拘而問之，其人曰：「我先笑者，笑許大天下將相無人。
units.en: Another man in hemp stood before Chengtian Gate, laughed three times, then wept three times; officials seized and questioned him; he said: "I laughed first because so great an empire lacked a single worthy minister or general.
units.literal: Again, a man in hemp garments facing Chengtian Gate laughed three times and wept three times; the authorities seized and questioned him; the man said: "My first laughter laughed that so vast an empire had not a single worthy minister or general.

units.zh: 後哭者，哀祖宗家國破蕩至此也。」
units.en: I wept afterward for the ancestral house and realm ruined to this point."
units.literal: My later weeping mourned that the ancestral house and state had been battered to this pass."

units.zh: 有司以為妖言，處之重典。
units.en: Officials called it sorcerous talk and sought the heaviest penalty.
units.literal: The authorities deemed it demonic speech and would punish it by the heavy statute.

units.zh: 上曰：「近詔草澤之士並許直言，雖涉譏訕亦不治罪，況此人言亦有理。
units.en: The emperor said: "A recent edict lets commoners speak plainly; even mockery goes unpunished; how much more when his words hold truth.
units.literal: The emperor said: "A recent edict allows men of the wilds to speak plainly; even if it touches on ridicule there is no crime; how much more when this man’s words have reason.

units.zh: 止不應哭笑闕下耳。」
