units.en: Only he should not have laughed and wept beneath the palace gates."
units.literal: Only he should not have laughed and wept below the palace gates."

units.zh: 乃杖之。
units.en: He was flogged with the staff.
units.literal: He was beaten with the staff.

units.zh: 二年正月甲申，有黃黑之昆。
units.en: Second year, first month, on jiashen: a yellow-black insect swarm appeared.
units.literal: Second year, first month, on jiashen, a yellow-black swarm appeared.

units.zh: 四月，旱。
units.en: In the fourth month there was drought.
units.literal: Fourth month, drought.

units.zh: 京畿大雨雹。
units.en: The capital region was struck by great hail.
units.literal: Great hail in the capital region.

units.zh: 三年春，大寒。
units.en: Third year, spring: bitter cold.
units.literal: Third year, spring, severe cold.

units.zh: 三月乙丑，有火自吏部中出，大如斛，流行輾轉，人皆驚避，逾時而滅。
units.en: Third month, on yichou: fire burst from the Ministry of Personnel, as large as a grain measure, rolling along the ground; people scattered in terror until it died away.
units.literal: Third month, on yichou, fire issued from within the Ministry of Personnel, large as a grain measure, rolling and turning as it moved; everyone fled in alarm; after a time it vanished.

units.zh: 四月，旱、蝗。
units.en: Fourth month brought drought and locusts.
units.literal: Fourth month, drought and locusts.

units.zh: 六月，京東雨雹，蝗死。
units.en: Sixth month: hail in the eastern capital and the locusts perished.
units.literal: Sixth month, hail in eastern capital; the locusts died.

units.zh: 四年六月丙辰，地震。
units.en: Fourth year, sixth month, on bingchen: an earthquake.
units.literal: Fourth year, sixth month, on bingchen, earthquake.

units.zh: 八月癸亥，大風吹左掖門鴟尾墜，丹鳳門扉壞。
units.en: Eighth month, on guihai: a gale tore the ridge-beast finial from the Left Flank Gate and shattered Danfeng Gate's doors.
units.literal: Eighth month, on guihai, a great wind blew the ridge-beast finial from the Left Flank Gate; Danfeng Gate panels were ruined.

units.zh: 是日，風、霜損禾皆盡。
units.en: That same day wind and frost laid the crops waste.
units.literal: That day wind and frost destroyed the grain entirely.

units.zh: 五年春，大寒。
units.en: Fifth year, spring: bitter cold.
units.literal: Fifth year, spring, severe cold.

units.zh: 二月，雷而雪。
units.en: Second month: thunder with snow.
units.literal: Second month, thunder and snow.

units.zh: 木之華者皆敗。
units.en: Every tree that had flowered was ruined.
units.literal: Trees that had blossomed all failed.

units.zh: 四月，鄭州大雨雹，桑柘皆枯。
units.en: Fourth month: great hail at Zheng Prefecture withered every mulberry and ramie plant.
units.literal: Fourth month, great hail at Zheng Prefecture; mulberry and ramie all withered.

units.zh: 京畿旱。
units.en: The capital region suffered drought.
units.literal: Drought in the capital region.

units.zh: 八月，御座上聞若有言者曰：「不放舍則何？」
units.en: Eighth month: on the imperial seat a voice seemed to say: "If you will not grant amnesty, then what?"
units.literal: Eighth month, upon the imperial seat a voice seemed to speak, saying: "If you do not grant amnesty, then what?"

units.zh: 索之不見。
units.en: A search found no one there.
units.literal: A search found no one.

units.zh: 七年十二月，新衛州北三里許，有影在沙上，如舊衛州城狀，寺塔宛然，數日乃滅。
units.en: Seventh year, twelfth month: three li north of new Weizhou a shadow on the sand took the shape of old Weizhou, temple towers plain as life, and faded only after several days.
units.literal: Seventh year, twelfth month, about three li north of new Weizhou, a shadow on the sand resembled old Weizhou city; temple towers stood clear; after several days it vanished.

units.zh: 天興元年正月丁酉，大雪。
units.en: In the first year of Tianxing, first month, on dingyou, heavy snow fell.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianxing, first month, on dingyou, heavy snow fell.

units.zh: 二月癸丑，又雪。
units.en: In the second month, on guichou, it snowed again.
units.literal: In the second month, on guichou, it snowed again.

units.zh: 戊午，又雪。
units.en: On wuwu, it snowed again.
units.literal: On wuwu, it snowed again.

units.zh: 是時，鈞州、陽邑、盧氏兵皆大敗。
units.en: At this time, the armies at Junzhou, Yangyi, and Lushi all suffered crushing defeats.
units.literal: At this time, the armies at Junzhou, Yangyi, and Lushi were all badly defeated.

units.zh: 五月，大寒如冬。
units.en: In the fifth month, bitter cold came as if it were winter.
units.literal: In the fifth month, there was great cold as in winter.

units.zh: 七月庚辰，兵刃有火。
units.en: In the seventh month, on gengchen, fire appeared on the blades of weapons.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on gengchen, there was fire on weapons’ blades.

units.zh: 閏八月己未，有箭射入宮中。
units.en: In the intercalary eighth month, on jiwei, an arrow was shot into the palace.
units.literal: In the intercalary eighth month, on jiwei, an arrow was shot into the palace.

units.zh: 九月辛丑，大雷，工部尚書蒲乃速震死。
units.en: In the ninth month, on xinchou, great thunder sounded, and Minister of Works Punaishu was struck dead.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on xinchou, there was great thunder, and Minister of Works Punaishu was struck dead.

units.zh: 二年六月，上遷蔡，自發歸德，連日暴雨，平地水數尺，軍士漂沒。
units.en: In the second year, sixth month, the emperor moved to Cai; from his departure from Guide, violent rain fell for days, water stood several chi deep on level ground, and soldiers were swept away and drowned.
units.literal: In the second year, sixth month, the emperor moved to Cai; from the time he departed Guide, violent rain fell for days, water on the level ground stood several chi deep, and soldiers were swept away and drowned.

units.zh: 及蔡始晴，複大旱數月。
units.en: Only when he reached Cai did the weather clear, but then severe drought returned for several months.
units.literal: When he reached Cai it first cleared, but then there was again great drought for several months.

units.zh: 識者以為不祥。
units.en: Those who understood such things took it as inauspicious.
units.literal: Those who understood such things considered it inauspicious.

units.zh: 初，南京未破一二年間，市中有一僧不知所從來，持一布囊貯棗，日散與市人無窮，所在兒童百十從之。
units.en: Earlier, one or two years before Nanjing fell, a monk appeared in the market from no one knew where, carrying a cloth bag of dates and handing them out endlessly each day; wherever he went, hundreds of children followed.
units.literal: Earlier, one or two years before Nanjing fell, there was a monk in the market, no one knew where he came from, who carried a cloth bag storing dates and each day scattered them endlessly to the people of the market; wherever he was, hundreds of children followed him.

units.zh: 又有一人拾街中破瓦，複以石擊碎之。
units.en: There was also a man who picked up broken tiles in the street and smashed them again with a stone.
units.literal: There was also a man who picked up broken tiles in the street and then smashed them again with a stone.

units.zh: 人皆以為狂，不曉其理，後乃知之，其意蓋欲使人早散，國家將瓦解矣。
units.en: Everyone thought them mad and did not understand the meaning; only later was it known: they likely meant that people should scatter early, for the state was about to break apart like shattered tiles.
units.literal: Everyone considered them mad and did not understand the principle; only later did they know it: their meaning was likely that they wished people to scatter early, for the state was about to break apart like tiles.

units.zh: 孝宣承統，纂修洪業，亦講論六藝，招選茂異，而蕭望之、梁丘賀、夏侯勝、韋玄成、嚴彭祖，尹更始以儒術進，劉向，王褒以文章顯，將相則張安世、趙充國、魏相、丙吉、於定國、杜延年，治民則黃霸、王成、龔遂、鄭弘、召信臣、韓延壽、尹翁歸、趙廣漢、嚴延年、張敞之屬，皆有功跡見述於世。
units.en: Emperor Xuan inherited the succession and carried forward the great enterprise. He too expounded the Six Arts and recruited outstanding men. Xiao Wangzhi, Liangqiu He, Xiahou Sheng, Wei Xuancheng, Yan Pengzu, and Yin Gengshi advanced through Confucian learning; Liu Xiang and Wang Bao gained distinction for their writing; among the generals and chancellors were Zhang Anshi, Zhao Chongguo, Wei Xiang, Bing Ji, Yu Dingguo, and Du Yannian; and among those who governed the people were Huang Ba, Wang Cheng, Gong Sui, Zheng Hong, Shao Xinchen, Han Yanshou, Yin Wengui, Zhao Guanghan, Yan Yannian, Zhang Chang, and others. All left achievements celebrated in their age.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan inherited the succession and carried forward the great enterprise. He too discussed the Six Arts and recruited outstanding men: Xiao Wangzhi, Liangqiu He, Xiahou Sheng, Wei Xuancheng, Yan Pengzu, and Yin Gengshi advanced through Confucian learning; Liu Xiang and Wang Bao gained distinction through literary composition; among the generals and chancellors were Zhang Anshi, Zhao Chongguo, Wei Xiang, Bing Ji, Yu Dingguo, and Du Yannian; among those who governed the people were Huang Ba, Wang Cheng, Gong Sui, Zheng Hong, Shao Xinchen, Han Yanshou, Yin Wengui, Zhao Guanghan, Yan Yannian, Zhang Chang, and others. All had achievements recounted in their age.

units.zh: 穆宗十年癸未，阿疏自遼使其徒達紀來說曷懶甸人，曷懶甸人執之。
units.en: In the tenth year of Muzong, guisi year, Ashu, acting for the Liao, sent his man Daji to win over the Halin district people, but they seized him.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Muzong, guisi year, Ashu, on behalf of the Liao, sent his follower Daji to win over the people of the Halin district; the people of Halin seized him.

units.zh: 昕曰：「箕子為之奴，何言無也？」
units.en: Xin said, "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?"
units.literal: Xin said: "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?"

units.zh: 司天提點張正之寫災異十六條，張承旨家手本載舊事五條，金禮部尚書楊雲翼日錄四十條，陳老日錄三十條，藏在史館。
units.en: Astronomy Commissioner Zhang Zhengzhi transcribed sixteen records of portents; a household manuscript at Academician Zhang's home preserved five old items; former Jin Minister of Rites Yang Yunyi left forty daily notes and Old Chen thirty — all kept in the History Office.
units.literal: Astronomy Commissioner Zhang Zhengzhi copied sixteen entries on calamities; five old affairs recorded in a hand copy at Academician Zhang's home; forty daily entries by former Jin Minister of Rites Yang Yunyi; thirty daily entries by Old Chen — all stored in the History Office.
